> Inventory your Render services (web service, workers, cron jobs), your environment variables, and your database.

Create the equivalents on Kloudbean: one always-on server running your app and workers under PM2, plus a managed PostgreSQL database. Copy env vars over, changing `DATABASE_URL` to the new instance. Dump and restore your data with `pg_dump` and `pg_restore`, verify on the temporary URL, then switch DNS.

Read the full guide: https://www.kloudbean.com/blog/migrate-render-to-kloudbean/
